title_en: Dream of the Red Chamber (13/20): Signs of Decline
note_en: In 田地的收入一年比一年少 "income from the land grew smaller every year," the pattern 一 + noun + 比 + 一 + noun + adjective expresses steady, cumulative change. English says "year after year" or "more and more," but Chinese literally compares each year with the one before: 一天比一天冷 "colder by the day."
